symptoms: Hypertensive Emergency: DBP >= 110 mmHg with acute target organ damage (encephalopathy, aortic dissection, ACS, pulmonary oedema, acute renal failure)

management_steps.details: Reduce MAP by 20-25% in first hour (except Aortic Dissection: target SBP < 100-120 mmHg within 20 minutes).
20mg IV bolus. Infusion preparation: 180mg in 200ml 0.9% N/S (0.76 mg/ml). Start at 80 ml/hr, increase by 10 ml/hr q5min to max 160 ml/hr (2 mg/min).
10mg in 200ml N/S (50 ug/ml). Start at 12 ml/hr (10 ug/min), double every 2 minutes to max 200 ug/min.
